propositions: On fresh upgrade (file absent), existing managed links with bound targets must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade records with source=backfill and direction=backfill, preventing the first post-upgrade removal pass from declining all legitimate peer deletions.
Backfill must not run when store file existed but is empty, only when file was absent; operator-cleared stores must not be silently re-populated.
Backfill must skip managed refs whose targets are unbound, and must not overwrite existing push or snapshot records (provenance never downgrades).

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once, with backfill running before snapshot confirmation on the same instance, ensuring backfilled records are visible to snapshot's record-overwrite and preventing lost-update races.
Backfilled records must be treated as confirmed by is_confirmed() without distinguishing backfill from proof at decision points, preserving grandfathering semantics for pre-upgrade links.
